1.zh: 大卫的儿子所罗门国位坚固；耶和华—他的　神与他同在，使他甚为尊大。
1.en: Solomon the son of David was firmly established in his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him, and made him exceedingly great.

1.zh: 所罗门吩咐以色列众人，就是千夫长、百夫长、审判官、首领与族长都来。
1.en: Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, to the judges, and to every prince in all Israel, the heads of the fathers’ households.

1.zh: 所罗门和会众都往基遍的邱坛去，因那里有　神的会幕，就是耶和华仆人摩西在旷野所制造的。
1.en: Then Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for God’s Tent of Meeting was there, which the LORD’s servant Moses had made in the wilderness.

1.zh: 只是　神的[约]柜，大卫已经从基列·耶琳搬到他所预备的[地方]，因他曾在耶路撒冷为[约]柜支搭了帐幕，
1.en: But David had brought God’s ark up from Kiriath Jearim to the place that David had prepared for it; for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

1.zh: 并且户珥的孙子、乌利的儿子比撒列所造的铜坛也在基遍耶和华的会幕前。所罗门和会众都就近坛前。
1.en: Moreover the bronze altar that Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was there before the LORD’s tabernacle; and Solomon and the assembly were seeking counsel there.

1.zh: 所罗门上到耶和华面前会幕的铜坛那里，献一千牺牲为燔祭。
1.en: Solomon went up there to the bronze altar before the LORD, which was at the Tent of Meeting, and offered one thousand burnt offerings on it.

1.zh: 当夜，　神向所罗门显现，对他说：「你愿我赐你什么，你可以求。」
1.en: That night, God appeared to Solomon and said to him, “Ask for what you want me to give you.”

1.zh: 所罗门对　神说：「你曾向我父大卫大施慈爱，使我接续他作王。
1.en: Solomon said to God, “You have shown great loving kindness to David my father, and have made me king in his place.

1.zh: 耶和华　神啊，现在求你成就向我父大卫所应许的话；因你立我作这民的王，他们如同地上尘沙那样多。
1.en: Now, LORD God, let your promise to David my father be established; for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

1.zh: 求你赐我智慧聪明，我好在这民前出入；不然，谁能判断这众多的民呢？」
1.en: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this great people of yours?”

1.zh: 神对所罗门说：「我已立你作我民的王。你既有这心意，并不求资财、丰富、尊荣，也不求灭绝那恨你之人的性命，又不求大寿数，只求智慧聪明好判断我的民；
1.en: God said to Solomon, “Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked riches, wealth, honor, or the life of those who hate you, nor yet have you asked for long life; but have asked for wisdom and knowledge for yourself, that you may judge my people, over whom I have made you king,

1.zh: 我必赐你智慧聪明，也必赐你资财、丰富、尊荣。在你以前的列王都没有这样，在你以后也必没有这样的。」
1.en: therefore wisdom and knowledge is granted to you. I will give you riches, wealth, and honor, such as none of the kings have had who have been before you, and none after you will have.”

1.zh: 于是，所罗门从基遍邱坛会幕前回到耶路撒冷，治理以色列人。
1.en: So Solomon came from the high place that was at Gibeon, from before the Tent of Meeting, to Jerusalem; and he reigned over Israel.

1.zh: 所罗门聚集战车马兵，有战车一千四百辆，马兵一万二千名，安置在屯车的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那里。
1.en: Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen that he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

1.zh: 王在耶路撒冷使金银多如石头，香柏木多如高原的桑树。
1.en: The king made silver and gold to be as common as stones in Jerusalem, and he made cedars to be as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

1.zh: 所罗门的马是从埃及带来的，是王的商人一群一群按着定价买来的。
1.en: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt and from Kue. The king’s merchants purchased them from Kue.

1.zh: 他们从埃及买来的车，每辆价银六百[舍客勒]，马每匹一百五十舍客勒。赫人诸王和亚兰诸王所买的车马，也是按这价值经他们手买来的。
1.en: They imported from Egypt then exported a chariot for six hundred pieces of silver and a horse for one hundred fifty. They also exported them to the Hittite kings and the Syrian kings.

2.zh: 所罗门定意要为耶和华的名建造殿宇，又为自己的国建造宫室。
2.en: Now Solomon decided to build a house for the LORD’s name, and a house for his kingdom.

2.zh: 所罗门就挑选七万扛抬的，八万在山上凿石头的，三千六百督工的。
2.en: Solomon counted out seventy thousand men to bear burdens, eighty thousand men who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred to oversee them.

2.zh: 所罗门差人去见泰尔王希兰，说：「你曾运香柏木与我父大卫建宫居住，[求你也这样待我]。
2.en: Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, “As you dealt with David my father, and sent him cedars to build him a house in which to dwell, so deal with me.

2.zh: 我要为耶和华—我　神的名建造殿宇，分别为圣献给他，在他面前焚烧美香，常摆陈设饼，每早晚、安息日、月朔，并耶和华—我们　神所定的节期献燔祭。这是以色列人永远的[定例]。
2.en: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to him, to burn before him incense of sweet spices, for the continual show bread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance forever to Israel.

2.zh: 我所要建造的殿宇甚大；因为我们的　神至大，超乎诸神。
2.en: “The house which I am building will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.

2.zh: 天和天上的天，尚且不足他居住的，谁能为他建造殿宇呢？我是谁？能为他建造殿宇吗？不过在他面前烧香而已。
2.en: But who is able to build him a house, since heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain him? Who am I then, that I should build him a house, except just to burn incense before him?

2.zh: 现在求你差一个巧匠来，就是善用金、银、铜、铁，和紫色、朱红色、蓝色[线]，并精于雕刻之工的巧匠，与我父大卫在犹大和耶路撒冷所预备的巧匠一同做工；
2.en: “Now therefore send me a man skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, and in purple, crimson, and blue, and who knows how to engrave engravings, to be with the skillful men who are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.

2.zh: 又求你从黎巴嫩运些香柏木、松木、檀香木到我这里来，因我知道你的仆人善于砍伐黎巴嫩的树木。我的仆人也必与你的仆人同工。
2.en: “Send me also cedar trees, cypress trees, and algum trees out of Lebanon, for I know that your servants know how to cut timber in Lebanon. Behold, my servants will be with your servants,

2.zh: 这样，可以给我预备许多的木料，因我要建造的殿宇高大出奇。
2.en: even to prepare timber in abundance for me; for the house which I am about to build will be great and wonderful.

2.zh: 你的仆人砍伐树木，我必给他们打好了的小麦二万歌珥，大麦二万歌珥，酒二万罢特，油二万罢特。」
2.en: Behold, I will give to your servants, the cutters who cut timber, twenty thousand cors of beaten wheat, twenty thousand baths of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.”

2.zh: 泰尔王希兰写信回答所罗门说：「耶和华因为爱他的子民，所以立你作他们的王」；
2.en: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, “Because the LORD loves his people, he has made you king over them.”

2.zh: 又说：「创造天地的耶和华—以色列的　神是应当称颂的！他赐给大卫王一个有智慧的儿子，使他有谋略聪明，可以为耶和华建造殿宇，又为自己的国建造宫室。
2.en: Huram continued, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, endowed with discretion and understanding, who would build a house for the LORD and a house for his kingdom.

2.zh: 「现在我打发一个精巧有聪明的人去，他是我父亲希兰所用的，
2.en: Now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, Huram-abi,

2.zh: 是但[支派]一个妇人的儿子。他父亲是泰尔人，他善用金、银、铜、铁、石、木，和紫色、蓝色、朱红色[线]与细麻制造各物，并精于雕刻，又能想出各样的巧工。请你派定这人，与你的巧匠和你父—我主大卫的巧匠一同做工。
2.en: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and his father was a man of Tyre. He is skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, in stone, in timber, in purple, in blue, in fine linen, and in crimson, also to engrave any kind of engraving and to devise any device, that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my lord David your father.

2.zh: 我主所说的小麦、大麦、酒、油，愿我主运来给众仆人。
2.en: “Now therefore, the wheat, the barley, the oil, and the wine which my lord has spoken of, let him send to his servants;

2.zh: 我们必照你所需用的，从黎巴嫩砍伐树木，扎成筏子，浮海运到约帕；你可以从那里运到耶路撒冷。」
2.en: and we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as you need. We will bring it to you in rafts by sea to Joppa; then you shall carry it up to Jerusalem.”

2.zh: 所罗门仿照他父大卫数点住在以色列地所有寄居的外邦人，共有十五万三千六百名；
2.en: Solomon counted all the foreigners who were in the land of Israel, after the census with which David his father had counted them; and they found one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred.

2.zh: 使七万人扛抬材料，八万人在山上凿石头，三千六百人督理工作。
2.en: He set seventy thousand of them to bear burdens, eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred overseers to assign the people their work.

3.zh: 所罗门就在耶路撒冷、[耶和华]向他父大卫显现的摩利亚山上，就是耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上、大卫所指定的地方预备好了，开工建造耶和华的殿。
3.en: Then Solomon began to build the LORD’s house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD appeared to David his father, which he prepared in the place that David had appointed, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

3.zh: 所罗门作王第四年二月初二日开工建造。
3.en: He began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

3.zh: 所罗门建筑　神殿的根基，乃是这样：长六十肘，宽二十肘，都按着古时的尺寸。
3.en: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of God’s house: the length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.

3.zh: 殿前的廊子长二十肘，与殿的宽窄一样，高一百二十肘；里面贴上精金。
3.en: The porch that was in front, its length, across the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height one hundred twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

3.zh: 大殿[的墙]都用松木板遮蔽，又贴了精金，上面雕刻棕树和链子；
3.en: He made the larger room with a ceiling of cypress wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains.

3.zh: 又用宝石装饰殿[墙]，使殿华美；所用的金子都是巴瓦音的金子。
3.en: He decorated the house with precious stones for beauty. The gold was gold from Parvaim.

3.zh: 又用金子贴殿和殿的栋梁、门槛、墙壁、门扇；墙上雕刻基路伯。
3.en: He also overlaid the house, the beams, the thresholds, its walls, and its doors with gold, and engraved cherubim on the walls.

3.zh: 又建造至圣所，长二十肘，与殿的宽窄一样，宽也是二十肘；贴上精金，共用金子六百他连得。
3.en: He made the most holy place. Its length, according to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.

3.zh: 金钉重五十舍客勒。楼房都贴上金子。
3.en: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He overlaid the upper rooms with gold.

3.zh: 在至圣所按造像的法子造两个基路伯，用金子包裹。
3.en: In the most holy place he made two cherubim by carving, and they overlaid them with gold.

3.zh: 两个基路伯的翅膀共长二十肘。这[基路伯]的一个翅膀长五肘，挨着殿这边的墙；那一个翅膀也长五肘，与那基路伯翅膀相接。
3.en: The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

3.zh: 那基路伯的一个翅膀长五肘，挨着殿那边的墙；那一个翅膀也长五肘，与这基路伯的翅膀相接。
3.en: The wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

3.zh: 两个基路伯张开翅膀，共长二十肘，面向[外]殿而立。
3.en: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves out twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.

3.zh: 又用蓝色、紫色、朱红色[线]和细麻织幔子，在其上绣出基路伯来。
3.en: He made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.

3.zh: 在殿前造了两根柱子，高三十五肘；每柱顶高五肘。
3.en: Also he made before the house two pillars thirty-five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.

3.zh: 又[照]圣所内[链子]的样式做链子，安在柱顶上；又做一百石榴，安在链子上。
3.en: He made chains in the inner sanctuary, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

3.zh: 将两根柱子立在殿前，一根在右边，一根在左边；右边的起名叫雅斤，左边的起名叫波阿斯。
3.en: He set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.

4.zh: 他又制造一座铜坛，长二十肘，宽二十肘，高十肘；
4.en: Then he made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.

4.zh: 又铸一个[铜]海，样式是圆的，高五肘，径十肘，围三十肘；
4.en: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round, five cubits high, and thirty cubits in circumference.

4.zh: 海周围有野瓜的样式，每肘十瓜，共有两行，是铸海的时候铸上的；
4.en: Under it was the likeness of oxen, which encircled it, for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast when it was cast.

4.zh: 有十二只[铜]牛驮海：三只向北，三只向西，三只向南，三只向东；海在牛上，牛尾向内；
4.en: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, three looking toward the west, three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.

4.zh: 海厚一掌，边如杯边，又如百合花，可容三千罢特；
4.en: It was a handbreadth thick. Its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It received and held three thousand baths.

4.zh: 又制造十个盆：五个放在右边，五个放在左边，献燔祭所用之物都洗在其内；但海是为祭司沐浴的。
4.en: He also made ten basins, and put five on the right hand and five on the left, to wash in them. The things that belonged to the burnt offering were washed in them, but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

4.zh: 他又照所定的样式造十个金灯台放在殿里：五个在右边，五个在左边；
4.en: He made the ten lamp stands of gold according to the ordinance concerning them; and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand and five on the left.

4.zh: 又造十张桌子放在殿里：五张在右边，五张在左边；又造一百个金碗；
4.en: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. He made one hundred basins of gold.

4.zh: 又建立祭司院和大院，并院门，用铜包裹门扇；
4.en: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid their doors with bronze.

4.zh: 将海安在[殿门的]右边，就是南边。
4.en: He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward, toward the south.

4.zh: 户兰又造了盆、铲、碗。这样，他为所罗门王做完了　神殿的工。
4.en: Huram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Huram finished doing the work that he did for King Solomon in God’s house:

4.zh: [所造的]就是：两根柱子和柱上两个如球的顶，并两个盖柱顶的网子
4.en: the two pillars, the bowls, the two capitals which were on the top of the pillars, the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars,

4.zh: 和四百石榴，安在两个网子上（每网两行盖着两个柱上如球的顶）。
4.en: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks—two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars.

4.zh: 盆座和其上的盆，
4.en: He also made the bases, and he made the basins on the bases—

4.zh: 海和海下的十二只牛，
4.en: one sea, and the twelve oxen under it.

4.zh: 盆、铲子、肉锸子，与耶和华殿里的一切器皿，都是巧匠户兰用光亮的铜为所罗门王造成的，
4.en: Huram-abi also made the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all its vessels for King Solomon, for the LORD’s house, of bright bronze.

4.zh: 是在约旦平原疏割和撒利但中间借胶泥铸成的。
4.en: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.

4.zh: 所罗门制造的这一切甚多，铜的轻重无法可查。
4.en: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance, so that the weight of the bronze could not be determined.

4.zh: 所罗门又造　神殿里的金坛和陈设饼的桌子，
4.en: Solomon made all the vessels that were in God’s house: the golden altar, the tables with the show bread on them,

4.zh: 并精金的灯台和灯盏，可以照例点在内殿前。
4.en: and the lamp stands with their lamps to burn according to the ordinance before the inner sanctuary, of pure gold;

4.zh: 灯台上的花和灯盏，并蜡剪都是金的，且是纯金的；
4.en: and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs of gold that was purest gold;

4.zh: 又用精金制造镊子、盘子、调羹、火鼎。至于殿门和至圣所的门扇，并殿的门扇，都是金子妆饰的。
4.en: and the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans of pure gold. As for the entry of the house, its inner doors for the most holy place and the doors of the main hall of the temple were of gold.

5.zh: 所罗门做完了耶和华殿的一切工，就把他父大卫分别为圣的金银和器皿都带来，放在　神殿的府库里。
5.en: Thus all the work that Solomon did for the LORD’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated, even the silver, the gold, and all the vessels, and put them in the treasuries of God’s house.

5.zh: 那时，所罗门将以色列的长老、各支派的首领，并以色列的族长招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和华的约柜从大卫城—就是锡安—运上来。
5.en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.

5.zh: 于是以色列众人在七月节[前]都聚集到王那里。
5.en: So all the men of Israel assembled themselves to the king at the feast, which was in the seventh month.

5.zh: 以色列众长老来到，利未人便抬起[约]柜。
5.en: All the elders of Israel came. The Levites took up the ark.

5.zh: 祭司利未人将[约]柜运上来，又将会幕和会幕的一切圣器具都带上来。
5.en: They brought up the ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The Levitical priests brought these up.

5.zh: 所罗门王和聚集到他那里的以色列全会众都在[约]柜前献牛羊为祭，多得不可胜数。
5.en: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel who were assembled to him were before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.

5.zh: 祭司将耶和华的[约]柜抬进内殿，就是至圣所，放在两个基路伯的翅膀底下。
5.en: The priests brought in the ark of the LORD’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubim.

5.zh: 基路伯张着翅膀在[约]柜之上，遮掩[约]柜和抬柜的杠。
5.en: For the cherubim spread out their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

5.zh: 这杠甚长，杠头在内殿前可以看见，在殿外却不能看见，直到如今还在那里。
5.en: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the ark in front of the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside; and it is there to this day.

5.zh: [约]柜里惟有两块石版，就是以色列人出埃及后，耶和华与他们立约的时候，摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，并无别物。
5.en: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

5.zh: 当时，在那里所有的祭司都已自洁，并不分班供职。
5.en: When the priests had come out of the holy place (for all the priests who were present had sanctified themselves, and didn’t keep their divisions;

5.zh: 他们出圣所的时候，歌唱的利未人亚萨、希幔、耶杜顿，和他们的众子众弟兄都穿细麻布衣服，站在坛的东边，敲钹、鼓瑟、弹琴，同着他们有一百二十个祭司吹号。
5.en: also the Levites who were the singers, all of them, even Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and their brothers, arrayed in fine linen, with cymbals and stringed instruments and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them one hundred twenty priests sounding with trumpets);

5.zh: 吹号的、歌唱的都一齐发声，声合为一，赞美感谢耶和华。吹号、敲钹，用各种乐器，扬声赞美耶和华[说]： 耶和华本为善， 他的慈爱永远长存！ 那时，耶和华的殿有云充满，
5.en: when the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of music, and praised the LORD, saying, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!” then the house was filled with a cloud, even the LORD’s house,

5.zh: 甚至祭司不能站立供职，因为耶和华的荣光充满了　神的殿。
5.en: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for the LORD’s glory filled God’s house.

6.zh: 那时，所罗门说： 耶和华曾说他必住在幽暗之处。
6.en: Then Solomon said, “The LORD has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

6.zh: 但我已经建造殿宇作你的居所， 为你永远的住处。
6.en: But I have built you a house and home, a place for you to dwell in forever.”

6.zh: 王转脸为以色列会众祝福，以色列会众就都站立。
6.en: The king turned his face, and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.

6.zh: 所罗门说：「耶和华—以色列的　神是应当称颂的！因他亲口向我父大卫所应许的，也亲手成就了。
6.en: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David my father, and has with his hands fulfilled it, saying,

6.zh: 他说：『自从我领我民出埃及地以来，我未曾在以色列众支派中选择一城建造殿宇为我名的居所，也未曾拣选一人作我民以色列的君；
6.en: ‘Since the day that I brought my people out of the land of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house in, that my name might be there, and I chose no man to be prince over my people Israel;

6.zh: 但选择耶路撒冷为我名的居所，又拣选大卫治理我民以色列。』」
6.en: but now I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.’

6.zh: 所罗门说：「我父大卫曾立意要为耶和华—以色列　神的名建殿，
6.en: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

6.zh: 耶和华却对我父大卫说：『你立意要为我的名建殿，这意思甚好；
6.en: But the LORD said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart;

6.zh: 只是你不可建殿，惟你所生的儿子必为我名建殿。』
6.en: nevertheless you shall not build the house, but your son who will come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.’

6.zh: 「现在耶和华成就了他所应许的话，使我接续我父大卫坐以色列的国位，是照耶和华所说的，又为耶和华—以色列　神的名建造了殿。
6.en: “The LORD has performed his word that he spoke; for I have risen up in the place of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

6.zh: 我将[约]柜安置在其中，柜内有耶和华的约，就是他与以色列人所立的约。」
6.en: There I have set the ark, in which is the LORD’s covenant, which he made with the children of Israel.”

6.zh: 所罗门当着以色列会众，站在耶和华的坛前，举起手来，
6.en: He stood before the LORD’s altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands

6.zh: （所罗门曾造一个铜台，长五肘，宽五肘，高三肘，放在院中）就站在台上，当着以色列的会众跪下，向天举手，
6.en: (for Solomon had made a bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high, and had set it in the middle of the court; and he stood on it, and knelt down on his knees before all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven).

6.zh: 说：「耶和华—以色列的　神啊，天上地下没有神可比你的！你向那尽心行在你面前的仆人守约施慈爱；
6.en: Then he said, “LORD, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth—you who keep covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart;

6.zh: 向你仆人—我父大卫所应许的话现在应验了。你亲口应许，亲手成就，正如今日一样。
6.en: who have kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.

6.zh: 耶和华—以色列的　神啊，你所应许你仆人—我父大卫的话说：『你的子孙若谨慎自己的行为，遵守我的律法，像你在我面前所行的一样，就不断人坐以色列的国位。』现在求你应验这话。
6.en: “Now therefore, LORD, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, ‘There shall not fail you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk in my law as you have walked before me.’

6.zh: 耶和华—以色列的　神啊，求你成就向你仆人大卫所应许的话。
6.en: Now therefore, LORD, the God of Israel, let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David.

6.zh: 「　神果真与世人同住在地上吗？看哪，天和天上的天尚且不足你居住的，何况我所建的这殿呢？
6.en: “But will God indeed dwell with men on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house which I have built!

6.zh: 惟求耶和华—我的　神垂顾仆人的祷告祈求，俯听仆人在你面前的祈祷呼吁。
6.en: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant and to his supplication, LORD my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you;

6.zh: 愿你昼夜看顾这殿，就是你应许立为你名的居所；求你垂听仆人向此处祷告的话。
6.en: that your eyes may be open toward this house day and night, even toward the place where you have said that you would put your name, to listen to the prayer which your servant will pray toward this place.

6.zh: 你仆人和你民以色列向此处祈祷的时候，求你从天上你的居所垂听，垂听而赦免。
6.en: Listen to the petitions of your servant and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear from your dwelling place, even from heaven; and when you hear, forgive.

6.zh: 「人若得罪邻舍，有人叫他起誓，他来到这殿，在你的坛前起誓，
6.en: “If a man sins against his neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and he comes and swears before your altar in this house,

6.zh: 求你从天上垂听，判断你的仆人，定恶人有罪，照他所行的报应在他头上；定义人有理，照他的义赏赐他。
6.en: then hear from heaven, act, and judge your servants, bringing retribution to the wicked, to bring his way on his own head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

6.zh: 「你的民以色列若得罪你，败在仇敌面前，又回心转意承认你的名，在这殿里向你祈求祷告，
6.en: “If your people Israel are struck down before the enemy because they have sinned against you, and they turn again and confess your name, and pray and make supplication before you in this house,

6.zh: 求你从天上垂听，赦免你民以色列的罪，使他们归回你赐给他们和他们列祖之地。
6.en: then hear from heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.

6.zh: 「你的民因得罪你，你惩罚他们，使天闭塞不下雨，他们若向此处祷告，承认你的名，离开他们的罪，
6.en: “When the sky is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, if they pray toward this place and confess your name, and turn from their sin when you afflict them,

6.zh: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你仆人和你民以色列的罪，将当行的善道指教他们，且降雨在你的地，就是你赐给你民为业之地。
6.en: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk, and send rain on your land, which you have given to your people for an inheritance.

6.zh: 「国中若有饥荒、瘟疫、旱风、霉烂、蝗虫、蚂蚱，或有仇敌犯境，围困城邑，无论遭遇什么灾祸疾病，
6.en: “If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight or mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemies besiege them in the land of their cities; whatever plague or whatever sickness there is—

6.zh: 你的民以色列，或是众人，或是一人，自觉灾祸甚苦，向这殿举手，无论祈求什么，祷告什么，
6.en: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, who will each know his own plague and his own sorrow, and shall spread out his hands toward this house,

6.zh: 求你从天上你的居所垂听赦免。你是知道人心的，要照各人所行的待他们（惟有你知道世人的心），
6.en: then hear from heaven your dwelling place and forgive, and give to every man according to all his ways, whose heart you know (for you, even you only, know the hearts of the children of men),

6.zh: 使他们在你赐给我们列祖之地上一生一世敬畏你，遵行你的道。
6.en: that they may fear you, to walk in your ways as long as they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.

6.zh: 「论到不属你民以色列的外邦人，为你的大名和大能的手，并伸出来的膀臂，从远方而来，向这殿祷告，
6.en: “Moreover, concerning the foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, when he comes from a far country for your great name’s sake and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm, when they come and pray toward this house,

6.zh: 求你从天上你的居所垂听，照着外邦人所祈求的而行，使天下万民都认识你的名，敬畏你，像你的民以色列一样，又使他们知道我建造的这殿是称为你名下的。
6.en: then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.

6.zh: 「你的民若奉你的差遣，无论往何处去与仇敌争战，向你所选择的城与我为你名所建造的殿祷告，
6.en: “If your people go out to battle against their enemies, by whatever way you send them, and they pray to you toward this city which you have chosen, and the house which I have built for your name;

6.zh: 求你从天上垂听他们的祷告祈求，使他们得胜。
6.en: then hear from heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

6.zh: 「你的民若得罪你（世上没有不犯罪的人），你向他们发怒，将他们交给仇敌掳到或远或近之地；
6.en: “If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to a land far off or near;

6.zh: 他们若在掳到之地想起罪来，回心转意，恳求你说：『我们有罪了，我们悖逆了，我们作恶了』；
6.en: yet if they come to their senses in the land where they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication to you in the land of their captivity, saying, ‘We have sinned, we have done perversely, and have dealt wickedly;’

6.zh: 他们若在掳到之地尽心尽性归服你，又向自己的地，就是你赐给他们列祖之地和你所选择的城，并我为你名所建造的殿祷告，
6.en: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, where they have been taken captive, and pray toward their land which you gave to their fathers, and the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name;

6.zh: 求你从天上你的居所垂听你民的祷告祈求，为他们伸冤，赦免他们的过犯。
6.en: then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, their prayer and their petitions, and maintain their cause, and forgive your people who have sinned against you.

6.zh: 「我的　神啊，现在求你睁眼看，侧耳听在此处所献的祷告。
6.en: “Now, my God, let, I beg you, your eyes be open, and let your ears be attentive to the prayer that is made in this place.

6.zh: 耶和华　神啊，求你起来， 和你有能力的[约]柜同入安息之所。 耶和华　神啊，愿你的祭司披上救恩； 愿你的圣民蒙福欢乐。
6.en: “Now therefore arise, LORD God, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength. Let your priests, LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let your saints rejoice in goodness.

6.zh: 耶和华　神啊，求你不要厌弃你的受膏者， 要记念向你仆人大卫所施的慈爱。」
6.en: “LORD God, don’t turn away the face of your anointed. Remember your loving kindnesses to David your servant.”

7.zh: 所罗门祈祷已毕，就有火从天上降下来，烧尽燔祭和别的祭。耶和华的荣光充满了殿；
7.en: Now when Solomon had finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the LORD’s glory filled the house.

7.zh: 因耶和华的荣光充满了耶和华殿，所以祭司不能进殿。
7.en: The priests could not enter into the LORD’s house, because the LORD’s glory filled the LORD’s house.

7.zh: 那火降下、耶和华的荣光在殿上的时候，以色列众人看见，就在铺石地俯伏叩拜，称谢耶和华[说]： 耶和华本为善， 他的慈爱永远长存！
7.en: All the children of Israel looked on, when the fire came down, and the LORD’s glory was on the house. They bowed themselves with their faces to the ground on the pavement, worshiped, and gave thanks to the LORD, saying, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!”

7.zh: 王和众民在耶和华面前献祭。
7.en: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.

7.zh: 所罗门王用牛二万二千，羊十二万献祭。这样，王和众民为　神的殿行奉献之礼。
7.en: King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated God’s house.

7.zh: 祭司侍立，各供其职；利未人也拿着耶和华的乐器，就是大卫王造出来、借利未人颂赞耶和华的。（他的慈爱永远长存！）祭司在众人面前吹号，以色列人都站立。
7.en: The priests stood, according to their positions; the Levites also with instruments of music of the LORD, which David the king had made to give thanks to the LORD, when David praised by their ministry, saying “For his loving kindness endures forever.” The priests sounded trumpets before them; and all Israel stood.

7.zh: 所罗门因他所造的铜坛容不下燔祭、素祭，和脂油，便将耶和华殿前院子当中分别为圣，在那里献燔祭和平安祭牲的脂油。
7.en: Moreover Solomon made the middle of the court that was before the LORD’s house holy; for there he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat.

7.zh: 那时所罗门和以色列众人，就是从哈马口直到埃及小河，所有的以色列人都聚集成为大会，守节七日。
7.en: So Solomon held the feast at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt.

7.zh: 第八日设立严肃会，行奉献坛的礼七日，守节七日。
7.en: On the eighth day, they held a solemn assembly; for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

7.zh: 七月二十三日，王遣散众民；他们因见耶和华向大卫和所罗门与他民以色列所施的恩惠，就都心中喜乐，各归各家去了。
7.en: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month, he sent the people away to their tents, joyful and glad of heart for the goodness that the LORD had shown to David, to Solomon, and to Israel his people.

7.zh: 所罗门造成了耶和华殿和王宫；在耶和华殿和王宫凡他心中所要做的，都顺顺利利地做成了。
7.en: Thus Solomon finished the LORD’s house and the king’s house; and he successfully completed all that came into Solomon’s heart to make in the LORD’s house and in his own house.

7.zh: 夜间耶和华向所罗门显现，对他说：「我已听了你的祷告，也选择这地方作为祭祀我的殿宇。
7.en: Then the LORD appeared to Solomon by night, and said to him, “I have heard your prayer, and have chosen this place for myself for a house of sacrifice.

7.zh: 我若使天闭塞不下雨，或使蝗虫吃这地的出产，或使瘟疫流行在我民中，
7.en: “If I shut up the sky so that there is no rain, or if I command the locust to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people,

7.zh: 这称为我名下的子民，若是自卑、祷告，寻求我的面，转离他们的恶行，我必从天上垂听，赦免他们的罪，医治他们的地。
7.en: if my people who are called by my name will humble themselves, pray, seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

7.zh: 我必睁眼看、侧耳听在此处所献的祷告。
7.en: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to prayer that is made in this place.

7.zh: 现在我已选择这殿，分别为圣，使我的名永在其中，我的眼、我的心也必常在那里。
7.en: For now I have chosen and made this house holy, that my name may be there forever; and my eyes and my heart will be there perpetually.

7.zh: 你若在我面前效法你父大卫所行的，遵行我一切所吩咐你的，谨守我的律例典章，
7.en: “As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances,

7.zh: 我就必坚固你的国位，正如我与你父大卫所立的约，说：『你[的子孙]必不断人作以色列的王。』
7.en: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom, according as I covenanted with David your father, saying, ‘There shall not fail you a man to be ruler in Israel.’

7.zh: 「倘若你们转去丢弃我指示你们的律例诫命，去事奉敬拜别神，
7.en: But if you turn away and forsake my statutes and my commandments which I have set before you, and go and serve other gods and worship them,

7.zh: 我就必将以色列人从我赐给他们的地上拔出根来，并且我为己名所分别为圣的殿也必舍弃不顾，使他在万民中作笑谈，被讥诮。
7.en: then I will pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have made holy for my name, I will cast out of my sight, and I will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

7.zh: 这殿虽然甚高，将来经过的人必惊讶说：『耶和华为何向这地和这殿如此行呢？』
7.en: This house, which is so high, everyone who passes by it will be astonished and say, ‘Why has the LORD done this to this land and to this house?’

7.zh: 人必回答说：『是因此地的人离弃耶和华—他们列祖的　神，就是领他们出埃及地的　神，去亲近别神，敬拜事奉他，所以耶和华使这一切灾祸临到他们。』」
7.en: They shall answer, ‘Because they abandoned the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and took other gods, worshiped them, and served them. Therefore he has brought all this evil on them.’”

8.zh: 所罗门建造耶和华殿和王宫，二十年才完毕了。
8.en: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the LORD’s house and his own house,

8.zh: 以后所罗门重新修筑希兰送给他的那些城邑，使以色列人住在那里。
8.en: Solomon built the cities which Huram had given to Solomon, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

8.zh: 所罗门往哈马琐巴去，攻取了那地方。
8.en: Solomon went to Hamath Zobah, and prevailed against it.

8.zh: 所罗门建造旷野里的达莫，又建造哈马所有的积货城，
8.en: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities, which he built in Hamath.

8.zh: 又建造上伯·和 、下伯·和 作为保障，都有墙，有门，有闩；
8.en: Also he built Beth Horon the upper and Beth Horon the lower, fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars;

8.zh: 又建造巴拉和所有的积货城，并屯车辆马兵的城，与耶路撒冷、黎巴嫩，以及自己治理的全国中所愿意建造的。
8.en: and Baalath, and all the storage cities that Solomon had, and all the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

8.zh: 至于国中所剩下不属以色列人的赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，
8.en: As for all the people who were left of the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel—

8.zh: 就是以色列人未曾灭绝的，所罗门挑取他们的后裔作服苦的[奴仆]，直到今日。
8.en: of their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel didn’t consume—of them Solomon conscripted forced labor to this day.

8.zh: 惟有以色列人，所罗门不使他们当奴仆做工，乃是作他的战士、军长的统领、车兵长、马兵长。
8.en: But of the children of Israel, Solomon made no servants for his work, but they were men of war, chief of his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.

8.zh: 所罗门王有二百五十督工的，监管工人。
8.en: These were the chief officers of King Solomon, even two-hundred fifty, who ruled over the people.

8.zh: 所罗门将法老的女儿带出大卫城，上到为她建造的宫里；因所罗门说：「耶和华[约]柜所到之处都为圣地，所以我的妻不可住在以色列王大卫的宫里。」
8.en: Solomon brought up Pharaoh’s daughter out of David’s city to the house that he had built for her; for he said, “My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places where the LORD’s ark has come are holy.”

8.zh: 所罗门在耶和华的坛上，就是在廊子前他所筑的坛上，与耶和华献燔祭；
8.en: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the LORD’s altar which he had built before the porch,

8.zh: 又遵着摩西的吩咐在安息日、月朔，并一年三节，就是除酵节、七七节、住棚节，献每日所当献的祭。
8.en: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, three times per year, during the feast of unleavened bread, during the feast of weeks, and during the feast of booths.

8.zh: 所罗门照着他父大卫所定的例，派定祭司的班次，使他们各供己事，又使利未人各尽其职，赞美[耶和华]，在祭司面前做每日所当做的；又派守门的按着班次看守各门，因为神人大卫是这样吩咐的。
8.en: He appointed, according to the ordinance of David his father, the divisions of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their offices, to praise and to minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required, the doorkeepers also by their divisions at every gate, for David the man of God had so commanded.

8.zh: 王所吩咐众祭司和利未人的，无论是管府库或办别的事，他们都不违背。
8.en: They didn’t depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasures.

8.zh: 所罗门建造耶和华的殿，从立根基直到成功的日子，工料俱备。这样，耶和华的殿全然完毕。
8.en: Now all the work of Solomon was accomplished from the day of the foundation of the LORD’s house until it was finished. So the LORD’s house was completed.

8.zh: 那时，所罗门往以东地靠海的以旬·迦别和以禄去。
8.en: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.

8.zh: 希兰差遣他的臣仆，将船只和熟悉泛海的仆人送到所罗门那里。他们同着所罗门的仆人到了俄斐，得了四百五十他连得金子，运到所罗门王那里。
8.en: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and brought from there four hundred fifty talents of gold, and brought them to King Solomon.

9.zh: 示巴女王听见所罗门的名声，就来到耶路撒冷，要用难解的话试问所罗门；跟随她的人甚多，又有骆驼驮着香料、宝石，和许多金子。她来见了所罗门，就把心里所有的对所罗门都说出来。
9.en: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to test Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great caravan, including camels that bore spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones. When she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.

9.zh: 所罗门将她所问的都答上了，没有一句不明白、不能答的。
9.en: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from Solomon which he didn’t tell her.

9.zh: 示巴女王见所罗门的智慧和他所建造的宫室、
9.en: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

9.zh: 席上的珍馐美味、群臣分列而坐、仆人两旁侍立，以及他们的衣服装饰、酒政，和酒政的衣服装饰，又见他上耶和华殿的台阶，就诧异得神不守舍，
9.en: the food of his table, the seating of his servants, the attendance of his ministers, their clothing, his cup bearers and their clothing, and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house, there was no more spirit in her.

9.zh: 对王说：「我在本国里所听见论到你的事和你的智慧实在是真的！
9.en: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

9.zh: 我先不信那些话，及至我来亲眼见了，才知道你的大智慧；人所告诉我的，还不到一半；你的实迹越过我所听见的名声。
9.en: However I didn’t believe their words until I came, and my eyes had seen it; and behold half of the greatness of your wisdom wasn’t told me. You exceed the fame that I heard!

9.zh: 你的群臣、你的仆人常侍立在你面前听你智慧的话是有福的。
9.en: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom.

9.zh: 耶和华—你的　神是应当称颂的！他喜悦你，使你坐他的国位，为耶和华—你的　神作王；因为你的　神爱以色列人，要永远坚立他们，所以立你作他们的王，使你秉公行义。」
9.en: Blessed be the LORD your God, who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for the LORD your God, because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever. Therefore he made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.”

9.zh: 于是示巴女王将一百二十他连得金子和宝石，与极多的香料送给所罗门王；她送给王的香料，[以后]再没有这样的。
9.en: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones. There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

9.zh: 希兰的仆人和所罗门的仆人从俄斐运了金子来，也运了檀香木和宝石来。
9.en: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.

9.zh: 王用檀香木为耶和华殿和王宫做台，又为歌唱的人做琴瑟；犹大地从来没有见过这样的。
9.en: The king used algum tree wood to make terraces for the LORD’s house and for the king’s house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers. There were none like these seen before in the land of Judah.

9.zh: 所罗门王按示巴女王所带来的，还她礼物，另外照她一切所要所求的，都送给她。于是女王和她臣仆转回本国去了。
9.en: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, more than that which she had brought to the king. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

9.zh: 所罗门每年所得的金子共有六百六十六他连得，
9.en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

9.zh: 另外还有商人所进的金子，并且阿拉伯诸王与[属]国的省长都带金银给所罗门。
9.en: in addition to that which the traders and merchants brought. All the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

9.zh: 所罗门王用锤出来的金子打成挡牌二百面，每面用金子六百[舍客勒]；
9.en: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold. Six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one large shield.

9.zh: 又用锤出来的金子打成盾牌三百面，每面用金子三百[舍客勒]，都放在黎巴嫩林宫里。
9.en: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold. Three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

9.zh: 王用象牙制造一个大宝座，用精金包裹。
9.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

9.zh: 宝座有六层台阶，又有金脚凳，与宝座相连。宝座两旁有扶手，靠近扶手有两个狮子站立。
9.en: There were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.

9.zh: 六层台阶上有十二个狮子站立，每层有两个：左边一个，右边一个；在列国中没有这样做的。
9.en: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. There was nothing like it made in any other kingdom.

9.zh: 所罗门王一切的饮器都是金的，黎巴嫩林宫里的一切器皿都是精金的。所罗门年间，银子算不了什么。
9.en: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. Silver was not considered valuable in the days of Solomon.

9.zh: 因为王的船只与希兰的仆人一同往他施去；他施船只三年一次装载金、银、象牙、猿猴、孔雀回来。
9.en: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with Huram’s servants. Once every three years, the ships of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

9.zh: 所罗门王的财宝与智慧胜过天下的列王。
9.en: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

9.zh: 普天下的王都求见所罗门，要听　神赐给他智慧的话。
9.en: All the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

9.zh: 他们各带贡物，就是金器、银器、衣服、军械、香料、骡马，每年有一定之例。
9.en: They each brought tribute: vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules every year.

9.zh: 所罗门有套车的马四千棚，有马兵一万二千，安置在屯车的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那里。
9.en: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen that he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.

9.zh: 所罗门统管诸王，从大河到非利士地，直到埃及的边界。
9.en: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

9.zh: 王在耶路撒冷使银子多如石头，香柏木多如高原的桑树。
9.en: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars to be as abundant as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

9.zh: 有人从埃及和各国为所罗门赶马群来。
9.en: They brought horses for Solomon out of Egypt and out of all lands.

9.zh: 所罗门其余的事，自始至终，不都写在先知拿单的书上和示罗人亚希雅的预言书上，并先见易多论尼八儿子耶罗波安的默示书上吗？
9.en: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, aren’t they written in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

9.zh: 所罗门在耶路撒冷作以色列众人的王共四十年。
9.en: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

9.zh: 所罗门与他列祖同睡，葬在他父大卫城里。他儿子罗波安接续他作王。
9.en: Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.

10.zh: 罗波安往示剑去，因为以色列人都到了示剑，要立他作王。
10.en: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

10.zh: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安先前躲避所罗门王，逃往埃及，住在那里；他听见这事，就从埃及回来。
10.en: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon), Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

10.zh: 以色列人打发人去请他，他就和以色列众人来见罗波安，对他说：
10.en: They sent and called him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came, and they spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

10.zh: 「你父亲使我们负重轭[做苦工]，现在求你使我们做的苦工负的重轭轻松些，我们就事奉你。」
10.en: “Your father made our yoke grievous. Now therefore make the grievous service of your father and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”

10.zh: 罗波安对他们说：「第三日再来见我吧！」民就去了。
10.en: He said to them, “Come again to me after three days.” So the people departed.

10.zh: 罗波安之父所罗门在世的日子，有侍立在他面前的老年人，罗波安王和他们商议，说：「你们给我出个什么主意，我好回复这民。」
10.en: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me about how to answer these people?”

10.zh: 老年人对他说：「王若恩待这民，使他们喜悦，用好话回复他们，他们就永远作王的仆人。」
10.en: They spoke to him, saying, “If you are kind to these people, please them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants forever.”

10.zh: 王却不用老年人给他出的主意，就和那些与他一同长大、在他面前侍立的少年人商议，
10.en: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.

10.zh: 说：「这民对我说：『你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些』；你们给我出个什么主意，我好回复他们。」
10.en: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may give an answer to these people, who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”

10.zh: 那同他长大的少年人说：「这民对王说：『你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些』；王要对他们如此说：『我的小拇指比我父亲的腰还粗；
10.en: The young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, “Thus you shall tell the people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter on us;’ thus you shall say to them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

10.zh: 我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭；我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子[鞭责打你们]。』」
10.en: Now whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”

10.zh: 耶罗波安和众百姓遵着罗波安王所说「你们第三日再来见我」的那话，第三日他们果然来了。
10.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”

10.zh: 罗波安王用严厉的话回复他们，不用老年人所出的主意，
10.en: The king answered them roughly; and King Rehoboam abandoned the counsel of the old men,

10.zh: 照着少年人所出的主意对他们说：「我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭；我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子[鞭责打你们]。」
10.en: and spoke to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”

10.zh: 王不肯依从百姓；这事乃出于　神，为要应验耶和华借示罗人亚希雅对尼八儿子耶罗波安所说的话。
10.en: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was brought about by God, that the LORD might establish his word, which he spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

10.zh: 以色列众民见王不依从他们，就对王说： 我们与大卫有什么分儿呢？ 与耶西的儿子并没有关涉！ 以色列人哪，各回各家去吧！ 大卫家啊，自己顾自己吧！ 于是，以色列众人都回自己家里去了。
10.en: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion do we have in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse! Every man to your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So all Israel departed to their tents.

10.zh: 惟独住在犹大城邑的以色列人，罗波安仍作他们的王。
10.en: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

10.zh: 罗波安王差遣掌管服苦之人的哈多兰往以色列人那里去，以色列人就用石头打死他。罗波安王急忙上车，逃回耶路撒冷去了。
10.en: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and the children of Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

10.zh: 这样，以色列人背叛大卫家，直到今日。
10.en: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.

11.zh: 罗波安来到耶路撒冷，招聚犹大家和便雅悯家，共十八万人，都是挑选的战士，要与以色列人争战，好将国夺回再归自己。
11.en: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, one hundred eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

11.zh: 但耶和华的话临到神人示玛雅说：
11.en: But the LORD’s word came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

11.zh: 「你去告诉所罗门的儿子犹大王罗波安和住犹大、便雅悯的以色列众人说，
11.en: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

11.zh: 耶和华如此说：『你们不可上去与你们的弟兄争战，各归各家去吧！因为这事出于我。』」众人就听从耶和华的话归回，不去与耶罗波安争战。
11.en: ‘The LORD says, “You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers! Every man return to his house; for this thing is of me.”’” So they listened to the LORD’s words, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

11.zh: 罗波安住在耶路撒冷，在犹大地修筑城邑，
11.en: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.

11.zh: 为保障修筑伯利恒、以坦、提哥亚、
11.en: He built Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,

11.zh: 伯·夙、梭哥、亚杜兰、
11.en: Beth Zur, Soco, Adullam,

11.zh: 迦特、玛利沙、西弗、
11.en: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,

11.zh: 亚多莱音、拉吉、亚西加、
11.en: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,

11.zh: 琐拉、亚雅 、希伯 。这都是犹大和便雅悯的坚固城。
11.en: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are fortified cities in Judah and in Benjamin.

11.zh: 罗波安又坚固各处的保障，在其中安置军长，又预备下粮食、油、酒。
11.en: He fortified the strongholds and put captains in them with stores of food, oil and wine.

11.zh: 他在各城里[预备]盾牌和枪，且使城极其坚固。犹大和便雅悯都归了他。
11.en: He put shields and spears in every city, and made them exceedingly strong. Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.

11.zh: 以色列全地的祭司和利未人都从四方来归罗波安。
11.en: The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel stood with him out of all their territory.

11.zh: 利未人撇下他们的郊野和产业，来到犹大与耶路撒 冷，是因耶罗波安和他的儿子拒绝他们，不许他们供祭司职分事奉耶和华。
11.en: For the Levites left their pasture lands and their possessions, and came to Judah and Jerusalem; for Jeroboam and his sons cast them off, that they should not execute the priest’s office to the LORD.

11.zh: 耶罗波安为邱坛、为鬼魔、为自己所铸造的牛犊设立祭司。
11.en: He himself appointed priests for the high places, for the male goat and calf idols which he had made.

11.zh: 以色列各支派中，凡立定心意寻求耶和华—以色列　神的，都随从利未人，来到耶路撒冷祭祀耶和华—他们列祖的　神。
11.en: After them, out of all the tribes of Israel, those who set their hearts to seek the LORD, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the LORD, the God of their fathers.

11.zh: 这样，就坚固犹大国，使所罗门的儿子罗波安强盛三年，因为他们三年遵行大卫和所罗门的道。
11.en: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong for three years, for they walked three years in the way of David and Solomon.

11.zh: 罗波安娶大卫儿子耶利摩的女儿玛哈拉为妻，又娶耶西儿子以利押的女儿亚比孩为妻。
11.en: Rehoboam took a wife for himself, Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse.

11.zh: 从她生了几个儿子，就是耶乌施、示玛利雅、撒罕。
11.en: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.

11.zh: 后来又娶押沙龙的女儿玛迦，从她生了亚比雅、亚太、细撒、示罗密。
11.en: After her, he took Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.

11.zh: 罗波安娶十八个妻，立六十个妾，生二十八个儿子，六十个女儿；他却爱押沙龙的女儿玛迦，比爱别的妻妾更甚。
11.en: Rehoboam loved Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines; for he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and became the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

11.zh: 罗波安立玛迦的儿子亚比雅作太子，在他弟兄中为首，因为[想要]立他接续作王。
11.en: Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief, the prince among his brothers, for he intended to make him king.

11.zh: 罗波安办事精明，使他众子分散在犹大和便雅悯全地各坚固城里，又赐他们许多粮食，[为他们]多寻妻子。
11.en: He dealt wisely, and dispersed some of his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city. He gave them food in abundance; and he sought many wives for them.

12.zh: 罗波安的国坚立，他强盛的时候就离弃耶和华的律法，以色列人也都随从他。
12.en: When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and he was strong, he abandoned the LORD’s law, and all Israel with him.

12.zh: 罗波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上来攻打耶路撒冷，因为王和民得罪了耶和华。
12.en: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had trespassed against the LORD,

12.zh: 示撒带战车一千二百辆，马兵六万，并且跟从他出埃及的路比人、苏基人，和古实人，多得不可胜数。
12.en: with twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen. The people were without number who came with him out of Egypt: the Lubim, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians.

12.zh: 他攻取了犹大的坚固城，就来到耶路撒冷。
12.en: He took the fortified cities which belonged to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

12.zh: 那时，犹大的首领因为示撒就聚集在耶路撒冷。有先知示玛雅去见罗波安和众首领，对他们说：「耶和华如此说：『你们离弃了我，所以我使你们落在示撒手里。』」
12.en: Now Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and to the princes of Judah, who were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, “The LORD says, ‘You have forsaken me, therefore I have also left you in the hand of Shishak.’”

12.zh: 于是王和以色列的众首领都自卑说：「耶和华是公义的。」
12.en: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, “The LORD is righteous.”

12.zh: 耶和华见他们自卑，耶和华的话就临到示玛雅说：「他们既自卑，我必不灭绝他们；必使他们略得拯救，我不借着示撒的手将我的怒气倒在耶路撒冷。
12.en: When the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the LORD’s word came to Shemaiah, saying, “They have humbled themselves. I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance, and my wrath won’t be poured out on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

12.zh: 然而他们必作示撒的仆人，好叫他们知道，服事我与服事外邦人有何分别。」
12.en: Nevertheless they will be his servants, that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.”

12.zh: 于是，埃及王示撒上来攻取耶路撒冷，夺了耶和华殿和王宫里的宝物，尽都带走，又夺去所罗门制造的金盾牌。
12.en: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem and took away the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He took it all away. He also took away the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

12.zh: 罗波安王制造铜盾牌代替那金盾牌，交给守王宫门的护卫长看守。
12.en: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.

12.zh: 王每逢进耶和华的殿，护卫兵就拿这盾牌，随后仍将盾牌送回，放在护卫房。
12.en: As often as the king entered into the LORD’s house, the guard came and bore them, then brought them back into the guard room.

12.zh: 王自卑的时候，耶和华的怒气就转消了，不将他灭尽，并且在犹大中间也有善益的事。
12.en: When he humbled himself, the LORD’s wrath turned from him, so as not to destroy him altogether. Moreover, there were good things found in Judah.

12.zh: 罗波安王自强，在耶路撒冷作王。他登基的时候年四十一岁，在耶路撒冷，就是耶和华从以色列众支派中所选择立他名的城，作王十七年。罗波安的母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人。
12.en: So King Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem and reigned; for Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

12.zh: 罗波安行恶，因他不立定心意寻求耶和华。
12.en: He did that which was evil, because he didn’t set his heart to seek the LORD.

12.zh: 罗波安所行的事，自始至终不都写在先知示玛雅和先见易多的史记上吗？罗波安与耶罗波安时常争战。
12.en: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, aren’t they written in the histories of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer, in the genealogies? There were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

12.zh: 罗波安与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城里。他儿子亚比雅接续他作王。
12.en: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in David’s city; and Abijah his son reigned in his place.

13.zh: 耶罗波安王十八年，亚比雅登基作犹大王，
13.en: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah began to reign over Judah.

13.zh: 在耶路撒冷作王三年。他母亲名叫米该亚，是基比亚人乌列的女儿。 亚比雅常与耶罗波安争战。
13.en: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

13.zh: 有一次亚比雅率领挑选的兵四十万摆阵，都是勇敢的战士；耶罗波安也挑选大能的勇士八十万，对亚比雅摆阵。
13.en: Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men; and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.

13.zh: 亚比雅站在以法莲山地中的洗玛脸山上，说：「耶罗波安和以色列众人哪，要听我说！
13.en: Abijah stood up on Mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, “Hear me, Jeroboam and all Israel:

13.zh: 耶和华—以色列的　神曾立盐约，将以色列国永远赐给大卫和他的子孙，你们不知道吗？
13.en: Ought you not to know that the LORD, the God of Israel, gave the kingdom over Israel to David forever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

13.zh: 无奈大卫儿子所罗门的臣仆、尼八儿子耶罗波安起来背叛他的主人。
13.en: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up, and rebelled against his lord.

13.zh: 有些无赖的匪徒聚集跟从他，逞强攻击所罗门的儿子罗波安；那时罗波安还幼弱，不能抵挡他们。
13.en: Worthless men were gathered to him, wicked fellows who strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tender hearted, and could not withstand them.

13.zh: 「现在你们有意抗拒大卫子孙手下所治耶和华的国，你们的人也甚多，你们那里又有耶罗波安为你们所造当作神的金牛犊。
13.en: “Now you intend to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David. You are a great multitude, and the golden calves which Jeroboam made you for gods are with you.

13.zh: 你们不是驱逐耶和华的祭司亚伦的后裔和利未人吗？不是照着外邦人的恶俗为自己立祭司吗？无论何人牵一只公牛犊、七只公绵羊将自己分别出来，就可作虚无之神的祭司。
13.en: Haven’t you driven out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made priests for yourselves according to the ways of the peoples of other lands? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may be a priest of those who are no gods.

13.zh: 至于我们，耶和华是我们的　神，我们并没有离弃他。我们有事奉耶和华的祭司，都是亚伦的后裔，并有利未人各尽其职，
13.en: “But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him. We have priests serving the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in their work.

13.zh: 每日早晚向耶和华献燔祭，烧美香，又在精[金]的桌子上摆陈设饼；又有金灯台和灯盏，每晚点起，因为我们遵守耶和华—我们　神的命；惟有你们离弃了他。
13.en: They burn to the LORD every morning and every evening burnt offerings and sweet incense. They also set the show bread in order on the pure table, and care for the gold lamp stand with its lamps, to burn every evening; for we keep the instruction of the LORD our God, but you have forsaken him.

13.zh: 率领我们的是　神，我们这里也有　神的祭司拿号向你们吹出大声。以色列人哪，不要与耶和华—你们列祖的　神争战，因你们必不能亨通。」
13.en: Behold, God is with us at our head, and his priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you. Children of Israel, don’t fight against the LORD, the God of your fathers; for you will not prosper.”

13.zh: 耶罗波安却在犹大人的后头设伏兵。这样，以色列人在犹大人的前头，伏兵在犹大人的后头。
13.en: But Jeroboam caused an ambush to come about behind them; so they were before Judah, and the ambush was behind them.

13.zh: 犹大人回头观看，见前后都有敌兵，就呼求耶和华，祭司也吹号。
13.en: When Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind them; and they cried to the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

13.zh: 于是犹大人呐喊；犹大人呐喊的时候，　神就使耶罗波安和以色列众人败在亚比雅与犹大人面前。
13.en: Then the men of Judah gave a shout. As the men of Judah shouted, God struck Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

13.zh: 以色列人在犹大人面前逃跑，　神将他们交在犹大人手里。
13.en: The children of Israel fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hand.

13.zh: 亚比雅和他的军兵大大杀戮以色列人，以色列人仆倒死亡的精兵有五十万。
13.en: Abijah and his people killed them with a great slaughter, so five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel fell down slain.

13.zh: 那时，以色列人被制伏了，犹大人得胜，是因倚靠耶和华—他们列祖的　神。
13.en: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied on the LORD, the God of their fathers.

13.zh: 亚比雅追赶耶罗波安，攻取了他的几座城，就是伯特利和属伯特利的镇市，耶沙拿和属耶沙拿的镇市，以法拉音和属以法拉音的镇市。
13.en: Abijah pursued Jeroboam, and took cities from him: Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephron with its villages.

13.zh: 亚比雅在世的时候，耶罗波安不能再强盛；耶和华攻击他，他就死了。
13.en: Jeroboam didn’t recover strength again in the days of Abijah. The LORD struck him, and he died.

13.zh: 亚比雅却渐渐强盛，娶妻妾十四个，生了二十二个儿子，十六个女儿。
13.en: But Abijah grew mighty and took for himself fourteen wives, and became the father of twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

13.zh: 亚比雅其余的事和他的言行都写在先知易多的传上。
13.en: The rest of the acts of Abijah, his ways, and his sayings are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.

14.zh: 亚比雅与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城里。他儿子亚撒接续他作王。亚撒年间，国中太平十年。
14.en: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Asa his son reigned in his place. In his days, the land was quiet ten years.

14.zh: 亚撒行耶和华—他　神眼中看为善为正的事，
14.en: Asa did that which was good and right in the LORD his God’s eyes,

14.zh: 除掉外邦神的坛和邱坛，打碎柱像，砍下木偶，
14.en: for he took away the foreign altars and the high places, broke down the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles,

14.zh: 吩咐犹大人寻求耶和华—他们列祖的　神，遵行他的律法、诫命；
14.en: and commanded Judah to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, and to obey his law and command.

14.zh: 又在犹大各城邑除掉邱坛和日像，那时国享太平；
14.en: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the sun images; and the kingdom was quiet before him.

14.zh: 又在犹大建造了几座坚固城。国中太平数年，没有战争，因为耶和华赐他平安。
14.en: He built fortified cities in Judah; for the land was quiet, and he had no war in those years, because the LORD had given him rest.

14.zh: 他对犹大人说：「我们要建造这些城邑，四围筑墙，盖楼，安门，做闩；地还属我们，是因寻求耶和华—我们的　神；我们既寻求他，他就赐我们四境平安。」于是建造城邑，诸事亨通。
14.en: For he said to Judah, “Let’s build these cities and make walls around them, with towers, gates, and bars. The land is yet before us, because we have sought the LORD our God. We have sought him, and he has given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered.

14.zh: 亚撒的军兵，出自犹大拿盾牌拿枪的三十万人；出自便雅悯拿盾牌拉弓的二十八万人。这都是大能的勇士。
14.en: Asa had an army of three hundred thousand out of Judah who bore bucklers and spears, and two hundred eighty thousand out of Benjamin who bore shields and drew bows. All these were mighty men of valor.

14.zh: 有古实王谢拉率领军兵一百万，战车三百辆，出来攻击犹大人，到了玛利沙。
14.en: Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah.

14.zh: 于是亚撒出去与他迎敌，就在玛利沙的洗法谷彼此摆阵。
14.en: Then Asa went out to meet him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

14.zh: 亚撒呼求耶和华—他的　神说：「耶和华啊，惟有你能帮助软弱的，胜过强盛的。耶和华—我们的　神啊，求你帮助我们；因为我们仰赖你，奉你的名来攻击这大军。耶和华啊，你是我们的　神，不要容人胜过你。」
14.en: Asa cried to the LORD his God, and said, “LORD, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has no strength. Help us, LORD our God; for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this multitude. LORD, you are our God. Don’t let man prevail against you.”

14.zh: 于是耶和华使古实人败在亚撒和犹大人面前，古实人就逃跑了；
14.en: So the LORD struck the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.

14.zh: 亚撒和跟随他的军兵追赶他们，直到基拉耳。古实人被杀的甚多，不能再强盛，因为败在耶和华与他军兵面前。犹大人就夺了许多财物，
14.en: Asa and the people who were with him pursued them to Gerar. So many of the Ethiopians fell that they could not recover themselves, for they were destroyed before the LORD and before his army. Judah’s army carried away very much booty.

14.zh: 又打破基拉耳四围的城邑；耶和华使其中的人都甚恐惧。犹大人又将所有的城掳掠一空，因其中的财物甚多，
14.en: They struck all the cities around Gerar, for the fear of the LORD came on them. They plundered all the cities, for there was much plunder in them.

14.zh: 又毁坏了群畜的圈，夺取许多的羊和骆驼，就回耶路撒冷去了。
14.en: They also struck the tents of those who had livestock, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, then returned to Jerusalem.

15.zh: 神的灵感动俄德的儿子亚撒利雅。
15.en: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded.

15.zh: 他出来迎接亚撒，对他说：「亚撒和犹大、便雅悯众人哪，要听我说：你们若顺从耶和华，耶和华必与你们同在；你们若寻求他，就必寻见；你们若离弃他，他必离弃你们。
15.en: He went out to meet Asa, and said to him, “Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin! The LORD is with you while you are with him; and if you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.

15.zh: 以色列人不信真神，没有训诲的祭司，也没有律法，已经好久了；
15.en: Now for a long time Israel was without the true God, without a teaching priest, and without law.

15.zh: 但他们在急难的时候归向耶和华—以色列的　神，寻求他，他就被他们寻见。
15.en: But when in their distress they turned to the LORD, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found by them.

15.zh: 那时，出入的人不得平安，列国的居民都遭大乱；
15.en: In those times there was no peace to him who went out, nor to him who came in; but great troubles were on all the inhabitants of the lands.

15.zh: 这国攻击那国，这城攻击那城，互相破坏，因为　神用各样灾难扰乱他们。
15.en: They were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God troubled them with all adversity.

15.zh: 现在你们要刚强，不要手软，因你们所行的必得赏赐。」
15.en: But you be strong! Don’t let your hands be slack, for your work will be rewarded.”

15.zh: 亚撒听见这话和俄德[儿子]先知亚撒利雅的预言，就壮起胆来，在犹大、便雅悯全地，并以法莲山地所夺的各城，将可憎之物尽都除掉，又在耶和华[殿]的廊前重新修筑耶和华的坛；
15.en: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill country of Ephraim; and he renewed the LORD’s altar that was before the LORD’s porch.

15.zh: 又招聚犹大、便雅悯的众人，并他们中间寄居的以法莲人、玛拿西人、西缅人。有许多以色列人归降亚撒，因见耶和华—他的　神与他同在。
15.en: He gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those who lived with them out of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon; for they came to him out of Israel in abundance when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.

15.zh: 亚撒十五年三月，他们都聚集在耶路撒冷。
15.en: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.

15.zh: 当日他们从所取的掳物中，将牛七百只、羊七千只献给耶和华。
15.en: They sacrificed to the LORD in that day, from the plunder which they had brought, seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep.

15.zh: 他们就立约，要尽心尽性地寻求耶和华—他们列祖的　神。
15.en: They entered into the covenant to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;

15.zh: 凡不寻求耶和华—以色列　神的，无论大小、男女，必被治死。
15.en: and that whoever would not seek the LORD, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

15.zh: 他们就大声欢呼，吹号吹角，向耶和华起誓。
15.en: They swore to the LORD with a loud voice, with shouting, with trumpets, and with cornets.

15.zh: 犹大众人为所起的誓欢喜；因他们是尽心起誓，尽意寻求耶和华，耶和华就被他们寻见，且赐他们四境平安。
15.en: All Judah rejoiced at the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found by them. Then the LORD gave them rest all around.

15.zh: 亚撒王贬了他祖母玛迦太后的位，因她造了可憎的偶像亚舍拉。亚撒砍下她的偶像，捣得粉碎，烧在汲沦溪边。
15.en: Also Maacah, the mother of Asa the king, he removed from being queen mother, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; so Asa cut down her image, ground it into dust, and burned it at the brook Kidron.

15.zh: 只是邱坛还没有从以色列中废去，然而亚撒的心一生诚实。
15.en: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel; nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

15.zh: 亚撒将他父所分别为圣、与自己所分别为圣的金银和器皿都奉到　神的殿里。
15.en: He brought the things that his father had dedicated and that he himself had dedicated, silver, gold, and vessels into God’s house.

15.zh: 从这时直到亚撒三十五年，都没有争战的事。
15.en: There was no more war to the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.

16.zh: 亚撒三十六年，以色列王巴沙上来攻击犹大，修筑拉玛，不许人从犹大王亚撒那里出入。
16.en: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign, Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

16.zh: 于是亚撒从耶和华殿和王宫的府库里拿出金银来，送与住大马士革的亚兰王便哈达，说：
16.en: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the LORD’s house and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben Hadad king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,

16.zh: 「你父曾与我父立约，我与你也要立约。现在我将金银送给你，求你废掉你与以色列王巴沙所立的约，使他离开我。」
16.en: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, as there was between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent you silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”

16.zh: 便·哈达听从亚撒王的话，派军长去攻击以色列的城邑。他们就攻破以云、但、亚伯·玛音，和拿弗他利一切的积货城。
16.en: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they struck Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim, and all the storage cities of Naphtali.

16.zh: 巴沙听见就停工，不修筑拉玛了。
16.en: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and let his work cease.

16.zh: 于是亚撒王率领犹大众人，将巴沙修筑拉玛所用的石头、木头都运去，用以修筑迦巴和米斯巴。
16.en: Then Asa the king took all Judah, and they carried away the stones and timber of Ramah, with which Baasha had built; and he built Geba and Mizpah with them.

16.zh: 那时，先见哈拿尼来见犹大王亚撒，对他说：「因你仰赖亚兰王，没有仰赖耶和华—你的　神，所以亚兰王的军兵脱离了你的手。
16.en: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said to him, “Because you have relied on the king of Syria, and have not relied on the LORD your God, therefore the army of the king of Syria has escaped out of your hand.

16.zh: 古实人、路比人的军队不是甚大吗？战车马兵不是极多吗？只因你仰赖耶和华，他便将他们交在你手里。
16.en: Weren’t the Ethiopians and the Lubim a huge army, with chariots and exceedingly many horsemen? Yet, because you relied on the LORD, he delivered them into your hand.

16.zh: 耶和华的眼目遍察全地，要显大能帮助向他心存诚实的人。你这事行得愚昧；此后，你必有争战的事。」
16.en: For the LORD’s eyes run back and forth throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. You have done foolishly in this; for from now on you will have wars.”

16.zh: 亚撒因此恼恨先见，将他囚在监里。那时亚撒也虐待一些人民。
16.en: Then Asa was angry with the seer, and put him in the prison; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. Asa oppressed some of the people at the same time.

16.zh: 亚撒所行的事，自始至终都写在犹大和以色列诸王记上。
16.en: Behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

16.zh: 亚撒作王三十九年，他脚上有病，而且甚重。病的时候没有求耶和华，只求医生。
16.en: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign, Asa was diseased in his feet. His disease was exceedingly great; yet in his disease he didn’t seek the LORD, but just the physicians.

16.zh: 他作王四十一年而死，与他列祖同睡，
16.en: Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the forty-first year of his reign.

16.zh: 葬在大卫城自己所凿的坟墓里，放在床上，其床堆满各样馨香的香料，就是按做香的作法调和的香料，又为他烧了许多的物件。
16.en: They buried him in his own tomb, which he had dug out for himself in David’s city, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odors and various kinds of spices prepared by the perfumers’ art; and they made a very great fire for him.

17.zh: 亚撒的儿子约沙法接续他作王，奋勇自强，防备以色列人，
17.en: Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and strengthened himself against Israel.

17.zh: 安置军兵在犹大一切坚固城里，又安置防兵在犹大地和他父亚撒所得以法莲的城邑中。
17.en: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

17.zh: 耶和华与约沙法同在；因为他行他祖大卫初行的道，不寻求巴力，
17.en: The LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and didn’t seek the Baals,

17.zh: 只寻求他父亲的　神，遵行他的诫命，不效法以色列人的行为。
17.en: but sought the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not in the ways of Israel.

17.zh: 所以耶和华坚定他的国，犹大众人给他进贡；约沙法大有尊荣资财。
17.en: Therefore the LORD established the kingdom in his hand. All Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had riches and honor in abundance.

17.zh: 他高兴遵行耶和华的道，并且从犹大除掉一切邱坛和木偶。
17.en: His heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD. Furthermore, he took away the high places and the Asherah poles out of Judah.

17.zh: 他作王第三年，就差遣臣子便·亥伊勒、俄巴底、撒迦利雅、拿坦业、米该亚往犹大各城去教训百姓。
17.en: Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, even Ben Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;

17.zh: 同着他们有利未人示玛雅、尼探雅、西巴第雅、亚撒黑、示米拉末、约拿单、亚多尼雅、多比雅、驼·巴多尼雅，又有祭司以利沙玛、约兰同着他们。
17.en: and with them Levites, even Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.

17.zh: 他们带着耶和华的律法书，走遍犹大各城教训百姓。
17.en: They taught in Judah, having the book of the LORD’s law with them. They went about throughout all the cities of Judah and taught among the people.

17.zh: 耶和华使犹大四围的列国都甚恐惧，不敢与约沙法争战。
17.en: The fear of the LORD fell on all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

17.zh: 有些非利士人与约沙法送礼物，纳贡银。阿 拉伯人也送他公绵羊七千七百只，公山羊七千七百只。
17.en: Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute. The Arabians also brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred male goats.

17.zh: 约沙法日渐强大，在犹大建造营寨和积货城。
17.en: Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.

17.zh: 他在犹大城邑中有许多工程，又在耶路撒冷有战士，就是大能的勇士。
17.en: He had many works in the cities of Judah; and men of war, mighty men of valor, in Jerusalem.

17.zh: 他们的数目，按着宗族，记在下面：犹大族的，千夫长押拿为首率领大能的勇士—三十万；
17.en: This was the numbering of them according to their fathers’ houses: From Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the captain, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valor;

17.zh: 其次是，千夫长约哈难率领[大能的勇士]—二十八万；
17.en: and next to him Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred eighty thousand;

17.zh: 其次是，细基利的儿子亚玛斯雅（他为耶和华牺牲自己）率领大能的勇士—二十万。
17.en: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to the LORD, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.

17.zh: 便雅悯族，是大能的勇士以利雅大率领拿弓箭和盾牌的—二十万；
17.en: From Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valor, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield;

17.zh: 其次是，约萨拔率领预备打仗的—十八万。
17.en: and next to him Jehozabad, and with him one hundred eighty thousand ready and prepared for war.

17.zh: 这都是伺候王的，还有王在犹大全地坚固城所安置的不在其内。
17.en: These were those who waited on the king, in addition to those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.

18.zh: 约沙法大有尊荣资财，就与亚哈结亲。
18.en: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honor in abundance; and he allied himself with Ahab.

18.zh: 过了几年，他下到撒马利亚去见亚哈；亚哈为他和跟从他的人宰了许多牛羊，劝他与自己同去攻取基列的拉末。
18.en: After some years, he went down to Ahab to Samaria. Ahab killed sheep and cattle for him in abundance, and for the people who were with him, and moved him to go up with him to Ramoth Gilead.

18.zh: 以色列王亚哈问犹大王约沙法说：「你肯同我去攻取基列的拉末吗？」他回答说：「你我不分彼此，我的民与你的民一样，必与你同去争战。」
18.en: Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, “Will you go with me to Ramoth Gilead?” He answered him, “I am as you are, and my people as your people. We will be with you in the war.”

18.zh: 约沙法对以色列王说：「请你先求问耶和华。」
18.en: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for the LORD’s word.”

18.zh: 于是以色列王招聚先知四百人，问他们说：「我们上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？」他们说：「可以上去，因为　神必将那城交在王的手里。」
18.en: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, four hundred men, and said to them, “Shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” They said, “Go up, for God will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

18.zh: 约沙法说：「这里不是还有耶和华的先知，我们可以求问他吗？」
18.en: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we may inquire of him?”

18.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说：「还有一个人，是音拉的儿子米该雅。我们可以托他求问耶和华，只是我恨他；因为他指着我所说的预言，不说吉语，常说凶言。」约沙法说：「王不必这样说。」
18.en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD; but I hate him, for he never prophesies good concerning me, but always evil. He is Micaiah the son of Imla.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”

18.zh: 以色列王就召了一个太监来，说：「你快去将音拉的儿子米该雅召来。」
18.en: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Get Micaiah the son of Imla quickly.”

18.zh: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法在撒马利亚城门前的空场上，各穿朝服坐在位上，所有的先知都在他们面前说预言。
18.en: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah each sat on his throne, arrayed in their robes, and they were sitting in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

18.zh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家造了两个铁角，说：「耶和华如此说：『你要用这角抵触亚兰人，直到将他们灭尽。』」
18.en: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron and said, “The LORD says, ‘With these you shall push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”

18.zh: 所有的先知也都这样预言说：「可以上基列的拉末去，必然得胜，因为耶和华必将那城交在王的手中。」
18.en: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead, and prosper; for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

18.zh: 那去召米该雅的使者对米该雅说：「众先知一口同音地都向王说吉言，你不如与他们说一样的话，也说吉言。」
18.en: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Let your word therefore, please be like one of theirs, and speak good.”

18.zh: 米该雅说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，我的　神说什么，我就说什么。」
18.en: Micaiah said, “As the LORD lives, I will say what my God says.”

18.zh: 米该雅到王面前，王问他说：「米该雅啊，我们上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？」他说：「可以上去，必然得胜，敌人必交在你们手里。」
18.en: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” He said, “Go up, and prosper. They shall be delivered into your hand.”

18.zh: 王对他说：「我当嘱咐你几次，你才奉耶和华的名向我说实话呢？」
18.en: The king said to him, “How many times shall I adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in the LORD’s name?”

18.zh: 米该雅说：「我看见以色列众民散在山上，如同没有牧人的羊群一般。耶和华说：『这民没有主人，他们可以平平安安地各归各家去。』」
18.en: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. The LORD said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”

18.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说：「我岂没有告诉你，这人指着我所说的预言，不说吉语，单说凶言吗？」
18.en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”

18.zh: 米该雅说：「你们要听耶和华的话。我看见耶和华坐在宝座上，天上的万军侍立在他左右。
18.en: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear the LORD’s word: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.

18.zh: 耶和华说：『谁去引诱以色列王亚哈上基列的拉末去阵亡呢？』这个就这样说，那个就那样说。
18.en: The LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One spoke saying in this way, and another saying in that way.

18.zh: 随后，有一个神灵出来，站在耶和华面前说：『我去引诱他。』耶和华问他说：『你用何法呢？』
18.en: A spirit came out, stood before the LORD, and said, ‘I will entice him.’ “The LORD said to him, ‘How?’

18.zh: 他说：『我去，要在他众先知口中作谎言的灵。』耶和华说：『这样，你必能引诱他，你去如此行吧！』
18.en: “He said, ‘I will go, and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ “He said, ‘You will entice him, and will prevail also. Go and do so.’

18.zh: 现在耶和华使谎言的灵入了你这些先知的口，并且耶和华已经命定降祸与你。」
18.en: “Now therefore, behold, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these your prophets; and the LORD has spoken evil concerning you.”

18.zh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家前来打米该雅的脸，说：「耶和华的灵从哪里离开我与你说话呢？」
18.en: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did the LORD’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”

18.zh: 米该雅说：「你进严密的屋子藏躲的那日，就必看见了。」
18.en: Micaiah said, “Behold, you shall see on that day, when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”

18.zh: 以色列王说：「将米该雅带回，交给邑宰亚们和王的儿子约阿施，说：
18.en: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;

18.zh: 『王如此说：把这个人下在监里，使他受苦，吃不饱喝不足，等候我平平安安地回来。』」
18.en: and say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.”’”

18.zh: 米该雅说：「你若能平安回来，那就是耶和华没有借我说这话了」；又说：「众民哪，你们都要听！」
18.en: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, the LORD has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, you people, all of you!”

18.zh: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法上基列的拉末去了。
18.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

18.zh: 以色列王对约沙法说：「我要改装上阵，你可以仍穿王服。」于是以色列王改装，他们就上阵去了。
18.en: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself, and go into the battle; but you put on your robes.” So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went into the battle.

18.zh: 先是亚兰王吩咐车兵长说：「他们的[兵将]，无论大小，你们都不可与他们争战，只要与以色列王争战。」
18.en: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”

18.zh: 车兵长看见约沙法便说，这必是以色列王，就转过去与他争战。约沙法一呼喊，耶和华就帮助他，　神又感动他们离开他。
18.en: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “It is the king of Israel!” Therefore they turned around to fight against him. But Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.

18.zh: 车兵长见不是以色列王，就转去不追他了。
18.en: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

18.zh: 有一人随便开弓，恰巧射入以色列王的甲缝里。王对赶车的说：「我受了重伤，你转过车来，拉我出阵吧！」
18.en: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of the chariot, “Turn around and carry me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded.”

18.zh: 那日阵势越战越猛，以色列王勉强站在车上抵挡亚兰人，直到晚上。约在日落的时候，王就死了。
18.en: The battle increased that day. However, the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the evening; and at about sunset, he died.

19.zh: 犹大王约沙法平平安安地回耶路撒冷，到宫里去了。
19.en: Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.

19.zh: 先见哈拿尼的儿子耶户出来迎接约沙法王，对他说：「你岂当帮助恶人，爱那恨恶耶和华的人呢？因此耶和华的忿怒临到你。
19.en: Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to King Jehoshaphat, “Should you help the wicked, and love those who hate the LORD? Because of this, wrath is on you from before the LORD.

19.zh: 然而你还有善行，因你从国中除掉木偶，立定心意寻求　神。」
19.en: Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you have put away the Asheroth out of the land, and have set your heart to seek God.”

19.zh: 约沙法住在耶路撒冷，以后又出巡民间，从别是巴直到以法莲山地，引导民归向耶和华—他们列祖的　神；
19.en: Jehoshaphat lived at Jerusalem; and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim, and brought them back to the LORD, the God of their fathers.

19.zh: 又在犹大国中遍地的坚固城里设立审判官，
19.en: He set judges in the land throughout all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city,

19.zh: 对他们说：「你们办事应当谨慎；因为你们判断不是为人，乃是为耶和华。判断的时候，他必与你们同在。
19.en: and said to the judges, “Consider what you do, for you don’t judge for man, but for the LORD; and he is with you in the judgment.

19.zh: 现在你们应当敬畏耶和华，谨慎办事；因为耶和华—我们的　神没有不义，不偏待人，也不受贿赂。」
19.en: Now therefore let the fear of the LORD be on you. Take heed and do it; for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of bribes.”

19.zh: 约沙法从利未人和祭司，并以色列族长中派定人，在耶路撒冷为耶和华判断，听[民间的]争讼，就回耶路撒冷去了。
